title: Eleven Weeks and One River
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：project　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 project 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In the spring of 1998 Daniel and I were given a ① project: eleven weeks, one question, and a mark worth a fifth of the year. We chose the river. It was the last thing we finished together and the only thing we ever did finish, which is a sentence I have spent years not saying to him. The ② project itself was never the difficulty.

We had, without meaning to, built a ③ project for proving each other wrong, and we were eleven weeks in before either of us noticed. He wanted to measure; I wanted to interview. I thought he was cold, he thought I was lazy, and we were both right. What neither of us said was that each of us was ④ projecting onto the other the thing he most disliked in himself.

The ⑤ school project went in on the Friday and we got the same mark, which we took as an insult and which was, I now see, the teacher being kind. That autumn a ⑥ housing project went up on the far side of the road, and I remember envying the men on it: their work was a project with an end to it, and ours was not.

Daniel became a teacher and then, in his forties, took on a ⑦ project for children who had left school at fifteen, which he is still running and which everyone says is the best thing he has done. I heard about it from somebody else. It sounds, from what I hear, like a ⑧ life's project rather than a job, and like the sort of project nobody is ever paid properly for.

I saw him in 2011 at a funeral, and we talked about the water for eleven minutes. He said the ⑨ research project had never been about the river at all. I said I knew. The ⑩ project of not saying so, which we began in 1998 and have never once discussed, is the longest thing either of us has worked on.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 项目；计划；方案
B. n. （学生的）课题作业；专题研究
C. n. （住房、基建等的）工程；建设项目
D. n. （公益、志愿服务类的）服务项目
E. 固定搭配：project sth. onto sb. 把……投射到别人身上
F. n. 盘算；打算；暗中做的事（a project for ...）
G. n. 科研项目；研究课题
H. n. 长期的工作；毕生的事业（a life's project）

items.q: The project itself was never the difficulty
built a project for proving each other wrong
The school project went in on the Friday
a housing project went up on the far side of the road
took on a project for children who had left school
like a life's project rather than a job
the research project had never been about the river
The project of not saying so

answers.why: project 意为“项目、任务”，1998 年春天我和 Daniel 被布置了那个项目。
the project itself 意为“项目本身”，说项目本身从来不是难事。
a project for doing 意为“做某事的盘算”，我们在不知不觉中搞了个证明对方错的盘算。
project sth. onto sb. 意为“把自己的东西投射到别人身上”，我们都把自己最讨厌的东西投射到了对方身上。
a school project 意为“学校里的课题作业”，那份作业星期五交了上去。
a housing project 意为“住宅工程、住宅建设项目”，那年秋天路那边建起一片住宅。
a project for ... 意为“面向……的服务项目”，他接手的是帮助十五岁辍学少年的公益项目。
a life's project 意为“毕生的事业”，听上去那不是一份工作而是他一辈子的事。
a research project 意为“研究课题”，他说那个课题从来就不是关于河的。
the project of ... 意为“……这件事／这项工程”，指我们谁也不说破的那件持续至今的事。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In the spring of 1998 Daniel and I were given a project: eleven weeks, one question, the river.
The project itself was never the difficulty; without meaning to, we had built a project for proving each other wrong.
Each of us was projecting onto the other the thing he most disliked in himself.
The school project went in on the Friday and we got the same mark, which we took as an insult.
